title: KLIA2 Capsule Hotel or Ride Now? Landing Late
metaDescription: Landing at KLIA2 late? Compare a CapsuleTransit capsule from RM135 for 3 hours with the last trains, late buses and a fixed price taxi.

contentBlocks.content: If you land at KLIA2 late at night, you have two choices: sleep a few hours at the airport or ride to your hotel now. The capsule hotel at KLIA2 you can use after landing is CapsuleTransit Landside, in the Gateway@klia2 mall, from RM135 for 3 hours. Two other airport hotels, Sama-Sama Express KLIA2 and CapsuleTransit Airside, are in international departures, so you cannot reach them once you clear immigration. If you would rather sleep in the city, the last trains leave around midnight to 1 AM, some buses run later, and a booked taxi runs at any hour. Decide before you board.
Key Takeaways
Is there a capsule hotel at KLIA2? Yes. CapsuleTransit Landside is in the public area of Gateway@klia2, beside the arrival hall, and you book it by the hour.
Which airport hotels can I not use after landing? Sama-Sama Express KLIA2 and CapsuleTransit Airside. Both are in international departures, for passengers flying out.
What time is the last train from KLIA2? The last KLIA Transit leaves KLIA2 at 12:30 AM. From 11 PM, KLIA Ekspres trains stop at every station.
What if I land after the last train? Some buses run after midnight, and a taxi booked ahead meets you in the arrival hall at any hour.

Sama-Sama Express says it cannot let guests back into the satellite area once they have cleared customs and immigration (Sama-Sama Express). If you are entering Malaysia, choose one of the first three.
CapsuleTransit at KLIA2

CapsuleTransit Landside has single capsules in female, male and mixed zones, shared rain showers, luggage lockers and a 24 hour reception. You book by the hour, from 3 hours to 24. CapsuleTransit MAX, also landside at KLIA2, has private rooms for two adults with their own shower and access to a lounge. Some booking sites still list the capsule hotel under its old name, Capsule by Container.

Tune Hotel KLIA-KLIA2

Tune Hotel KLIA-KLIA2 has private rooms with their own bathroom, a short walk from the terminal. After the arrival hall, walk towards FamilyMart, take the escalator down to Level 1M, turn right and follow the signs to the covered bridge. Tune Hotels puts the walk at 8 to 12 minutes (Tune Hotels). Day use rooms run from 7 AM to 7 PM, and a hotel shuttle to KLIA Terminal 1 leaves at 5, 7, 9 and 11 AM if you book a seat. Check room prices on the Tune Hotels website and book before you land.
Or ride now: what still runs late
Train

From 11 PM, all KLIA Ekspres trains stop at every station, so the trip to KL Sentral takes longer, and the KLIA Ekspres website says the late service runs until about 1 AM (KLIA Ekspres). The last KLIA Transit leaves KLIA2 at 12:30 AM and reaches KL Sentral at 1:09 AM (KLIA Transit). The ticket counters close at 11 PM. Buy online before you land; it takes 10% off the fare.
Bus

Some bus operators run from KLIA2 after midnight, but the times change. Check the night's departures on ttklia.com before you fly. Buses leave from the Transportation Hub on Level 1; our KLIA2 bus station guide shows the walk.
Taxi or Grab

Grab picks up from the LG floor of the Transportation Hub. Fares change with demand, so the price after midnight can be very different from the price at noon. A taxi booked on ttklia.com has its price fixed when you book. Your driver tracks your flight and waits in the arrival hall with a name board. Our KLIA2 taxi counter guide shows where to book at the airport instead.

contentBlocks.content: Stay or go: how to decide

• You land before 11 PM with light bags. Take the train. Our KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide compares it with the bus.
  • You land after midnight and your hotel is in the city. Book a taxi, and read the KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang guide if you are staying there.
  • You fly out again early the next morning. A capsule or a Tune room saves two airport rides.
  • Your next flight leaves from KLIA Terminal 1. Read our KLIA1 to KLIA2 guide for the morning trains and shuttle.
  • You are a family. A single capsule sleeps one adult. Compare a private room with a taxi to your city hotel.
Match your landing time to one of these, then book before you board.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is there a capsule hotel at KLIA2?
Yes, there is a capsule hotel at KLIA2. CapsuleTransit Landside is in the Gateway@klia2 mall, beside the arrival hall, and you can use it after you clear immigration.
How much is the capsule hotel at KLIA2?

The capsule hotel at KLIA2 costs RM135 for 3 hours, RM155 for 6 hours, RM175 for 12 hours and RM195 for 24 hours for a single capsule, on the CapsuleTransit Landside page checked 11 October 2026. Prices change, so check before you book.
Can I stay at Sama-Sama Express KLIA2 after landing?
No, you cannot stay at Sama-Sama Express KLIA2 after landing in Malaysia. It is in the international departure area, and once you clear immigration you cannot go back airside.
What time is the last train from KLIA2?
The last KLIA Transit train from KLIA2 leaves at 12:30 AM. KLIA Ekspres trains stop at every station from 11 PM, with late service until about 1 AM. Check the KLIA Ekspres website on the day.
Is Capsule by Container the same as CapsuleTransit?
Yes, Capsule by Container is the old name some booking sites still use for CapsuleTransit at KLIA2.
Conclusion

Landing late at KLIA2, you can sleep at CapsuleTransit Landside from RM135 for 3 hours, walk to Tune Hotel KLIA-KLIA2, or ride now. The last trains leave around midnight to 1 AM and some buses run later. If you want a car waiting at any hour, book your KLIA2 taxi on ttklia.com before you fly.
